design: One exploratory complete-session trial per agent on a purposive subset; no dataflow run and no engine changes. Outcome-dependent retries are not part of this diagnostic pilot.
subset: custom 8 sessions drawn from official Lite
judge_note: DeepSeek-V4-Pro matches the judge family specified in LongDS paper v3, section 3.4. OpenRouter model ID is pinned explicitly.

tasks.rationale: The paper illustrates this evolving market-score analysis; composition of historical components and current screens.
Restaurant and brand populations, revised commercial rules, and attribution across decision versions.
Persistent adopter definitions change from narrow to broad; earlier populations are reused for comparisons.
Joined working data, different temporal populations, and reuse of derived state-level features.
Ranking conventions, revised score definitions, and counterfactual indicator comparisons.
Changing working samples, persistent weights, and local perturbations of multicomponent scores.
Evolving poverty and partner definitions; combined stress tests must preserve the default recommendation state.
Long chains of player and team views, historical speed definitions, pool changes, and late composition.

status: Complete: 16 runs, 542 turn judgments, all verdicts present.
questions_to_audit: Was the required working state materialized and retained after its defining request?
Did the current request consume the intended population and current or historical definition?
Did a temporary scenario preserve the ongoing default?
Did a correction update all dependent calculations, or only the latest report?
Did recomputation introduce a new interpretation or precision drift?
Did failures arise from analytical reasoning, execution restrictions, context limits, or state handling?
Would explicit lineage or another dataflow representation have prevented the observed first divergence?
interpretation_limits: A single exploratory trial is diagnostic, not a reliable model or framework ranking.
The smolagents custom prompt is deliberately enabled; results compare these configured agents, not only execution runtimes.
State-pattern metadata and references are used only for offline selection, judging and audit, never agent prompts or code execution.
This purposive v1.1 subset, model, and smolagents configuration differ from the published v1 experiment; scores are not a direct reproduction.
The current runner dollar fields are Luna-equivalent accounting; actual agent-provider charges are unavailable from zero-rate gateway metadata.
input_hygiene: Every listed source file and its content hash verified against pinned HF revision. University directory had no extras. Remaining tasks use private copies of only official files.
invalid_attempts: Initial Netflix pair aborted after shared-directory leftovers were discovered; preserved separately and excluded. Both arms then used clean inputs. No other task session was restarted.
infrastructure_recovery: The clean-input smolagents Netflix attempt returned no model response; preserved separately and repeated over /v1. Its endpoint diagnostic response was never executed or supplied. All other completed runs were preserved.
sampling_note: DSGym requests temperature 0; the smolagents GPT-5 wrapper omits a non-default temperature. Both request medium reasoning. This compares configured systems, not a matched executor-only intervention.
